OTA-1866 — a question is asked once

#191. Owner's contract for a vendor conversation: a question is asked
once, the answer lands once, the conversation remembers it, and the
question is not offered again for that character.

MEASURED VIOLATION, bundle muc6fh1tj2l7 of 2026-09-22: 79 asks in 25.1s
against Ilva Sidelong, three rotating options, "I have told you that
one." every time, ~200ms apart, input healthy, conversation exited
normally. Ilva is roadside:ilva_sidelong -> class:roadside, and the
three labels in the trace are exactly that class's topics open at
familiar regard: c_front / c_known / cls_roadside_pitch.

CLASS ERROR, NOT AN ILVA ONE — and not where the symptom pointed. The
engine was right throughout. OTA-1784 made a class set's lines PARALLEL
VOICES (one answer per person, not a repeat sequence) and introduced
answersAvailable to say so; raiseTopic's already-said guard and
hasUnspokenTalk's glow were both moved onto it, the glow's own comment
reading "on lines.length a laned trader's glow never dims". TalkSheet
was not moved. It kept asking talked >= topic.lines.length.

For class:roadside — six lanes per topic — that is 1 >= 6, false. And
permanently false: raiseTopic returns on the already-said path BEFORE
the counter write, so the counter freezes at 1 and can never reach 6.
The row stayed undimmed, unsunk, unlabelled and pressable for the rest
of that character's life. 79 presses is only how long the owner kept
pressing.

CENSUS (41 topic sets: 30 authored NPCs, 11 class sets; 347 topics).
class:roadside is the ONLY set where the two readers disagree: its six
topics carry six lines each, while every other class set has one line
per topic (1 >= 1 agrees) and an authored set's answersAvailable IS
lines.length (agrees by construction). 6 questions violating, 1 set, 0
identity collisions, 0 duplicate ids within a set, 0 unstable ids.

REPAIR — one authority, not a patch per reader. topicSpent(topic,
npcId, talked) lives beside answersAvailable; the store's guard, the
TALK glow and the topic list all ask it. It takes the topic and the
person rather than a caller-supplied count, so a reader cannot pass the
wrong number any more: the divergence is made unrepresentable rather
than corrected twice and hoped about.

NOT A RACE, and proven so rather than assumed: raiseTopic latches the
counter synchronously inside the call that accepts the selection, so 50
back-to-back presses in one tick yield exactly one authored answer
before and after the repair. Rapid pressing exposed the defect; a
debounce would not have touched it.

Dialogue text, authored answers, gates, grants, flourishes, vendor
inventory, prices, standing and navigation are untouched. No line of
authored prose changed.

NEW SUITE ota1866TheQuestionIsAskedOnce 24/24 — corpus identity, the
ask-once lifecycle driven through raiseTopic for all 41 sets, the
rendered TalkSheet tray for a laned multi-line class / a laned
single-line class / an authored person, reopen, save round-trip, legacy
saves starting clean, cross-vendor and cross-character isolation, the
grant-idempotency check, and the Ilva fixture including the 79-press
device loop. Eight of the 24 were red before the repair and the two
already-agreeing classes were green, which is what isolated the class.

NEGATIVE CONTROLS: consumed-state filtering removed -> 11 red; vendor
identity dropped from the key -> 11 red; save/load dropping the memory
-> 1 red. Production was restored, not left patched. The brief's fourth
control (state written after narration rather than at acceptance) does
not apply: timing is not part of the proven defect.

ALSO CORRECTED: ota1865's own build-stamp pin, which asserted the live
OTA_BUILD_ID and so went red on the next OTA for no defect. check:otastamp
already ties the stamp to the newest suite and is a gate, not a test.

Gates: typecheck:ci clean, typecheck:tests 196 baseline no growth, lint
clean, 22/22 check:* (storeceiling at 36815, quotedpins 112/112), fast
surface 1364/1364 suites, 15,666 passed / 3 skipped, exit 0. No Heavy.

NOT CLAIMED: anything about NPC conversation outside the sets this same
machinery governs.
